description: An existing memory is authoritatively replaced; the answer must follow the new value.
scenario: You are an office assistant for a small startup called Ferric Labs. Users give you information over time and occasionally ask you questions. Answer precisely using the information provided in this conversation.

events.text: For the record, I love coffee. Always go with coffee for me.
Actually, I've switched to tea now — please use that preference from now on.
Do you know any good bike shops near the office?
What should I order at the cafe given my drink preference?

query: What should I order at the cafe given my drink preference?
expected_memory_operation: memory.add(m1 = coffee) at e1; memory.update(m1 -> tea) at e2 (authoritative replacement); answer follows tea.
